recommendation: Keep the empty external-repo audit commit. Do not reintroduce the extension definition or remove the OID mapping in core; any future wording/status adjustment belongs in HL7/fhir-extensions and should account for FHIR-43396.
issue_request: FHIR-40732 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core vocab request to deprecate the codesystem-conceptOrder extension because ordering is context/value-set specific rather than inherent to CodeSystem concepts.
initial_application: The core extension definition was removed from FHIR core by dd468d4f17 before this Jira was applied. The original deprecation application happened in HL7/fhir-extensions commit 2d8d674, which added deprecated standards-status to StructureDefinition-codesystem-conceptOrder.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-43385 added the standard core CodeSystem concept property order for R6. FHIR-43396 later refined the extension disposition from deprecation to version-specific use before R6. Current Extension Pack source has version-specific-use endFhirVersion 5.0 and description text pointing R6+ users to the order property.
reconciliation: No FHIR-core source was changed. The only current core matches are OID mappings, while the live StructureDefinition is in the FHIR Extension Pack and already reflects the later version-specific-use resolution.

related_jiras.note: Added the standard CodeSystem order concept property in core, providing the replacement mechanism cited by the current extension text.
Published FHIR-extensions issue for the same extension that refined the outcome to restricting use to versions prior to R6.
